'''Jeru''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was a member of the [[Wind Raiders/Legends|Wind Raiders]] tribe on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Taloraan/Legends|Taloraan]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], while performing a flight on his [[Fleft-wauf/Legends|fleft-wauf]] named [[Stormwing]], Jeru caught a [[Togruta/Legends|Togruta]] [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|female]] falling from the sky and intended to take her as a prize. Another Wind Raider, [[Nardek]], disputed his claim and [[Bafor]], the tribe's [[Chief/Legends|Chief]], decided that the two would have to fight over the female. The female, [[Padawan/Legends|Jedi Padawan]] Ahsoka Tano, refused to be anyone's prize, and insisted on joining the combat as well. Physically stronger, Nardek quickly defeated Jeru and was going to take the Togruta for himself. Ahsoka, however, surprised him by demonstrating her extreme agility and easily defeated him, using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After the fight was over, she tried to convince Bafor to let his [[Wind Raiders/Legends|Wind Raiders]] join combat against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] forces that were trying to establish control over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. Bafor initially refused to help, saying that it was the matter of the [[Denfrandi]], not the Wind Raiders. Jeru supported Jedi's plea for help, mentioning the [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|Separatist ship]] he saw in the clouds. After the Jedi offered the Wind Raiders some supplies and goods from [[Taloraan City]], several Wind Riders, including Jeru, agreed to join combat against the CIS forces. Jeru delivered Ahsoka to a site of a small skirmish between her Master, [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s, and later helped his fleft-wauf Stormwing to destroy a [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture Droid]]. After the battle was over, Jeru announced that Bafor made Ahsoka an honorary Wind Rider and took her to ride a fleft-wauf.
